title: neamscraft
description: a mod about beating the evil neams
body:
MOD FILES GOT CORRUPTED UH OH
 

a mod I made about a my friend. I spent way to long convincing him to let me upload this but finnaly he let me :)

I put way to much effort into this for it to go to waste.

 

really cool

 

the dandruff block is the catlyst for everything in this mod

you can use this to summon neams

once neams is beaten you go to the neams dimension

 

the neams dimension is where you get the best armour possible

 

lore:

you beat neams and get your place swapped with an evil neam known as ultemete neamstrap(I can spell ultimate)

who takes over the world and its up to you to stop him :0

 

bosses:

neams cultist leader no image(im lazy)

health:100

armour:10
